entities.name: Kinnan
entities.description: A very young human druid prodigy of Ikoria who can bond with many monsters and has poor manners.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who asked Kinnan how he bonds with many monsters.

events.summary: Vivien Reid asks Kinnan how he bonds with many monsters, but he growls at her and rides off on one of his beasts.
events.quote: he just growled at her before riding off on the back of one of his beasts
